canada.title: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, president
canada.summary: NVIDIA, one of the world’s largest semiconductor companies, has reinstated Jensen Huang as its CEO and president following weeks of controversy.

canada.title: ‘It’s OK to be not OK’: People recovering from addiction, support staff on treatment in the N.W.T.
canada.summary: In Canada, Nov. 15 to 21 is National Addictions Awareness Week, and CBC has gathered stories from northerners who have faced addiction, and workers who support them. They’ve shared their stories, and the unique obstacles they faced to get to where they are today.

canada.title: Funding cuts leave northern cadets out in the cold
canada.summary: The federal government is investing heavily in the North, but some people involved with the cadet program say Department of National Defence is short changing northern kids.

canada.title: B.C. trial in author Stephen Galloway’s defamation lawsuit enters final week
canada.summary: Final submissions in the trial of author and former UBC professor Stephen Galloway's defamation lawsuit are set to begin in B.C. Supreme Court in Vancouver Monday.

canada.title: B.C. Greens take the oath of office as Leader Lowan laments failed climate conference
canada.summary: Green Party Leader Emily Lowan and her caucus colleague Jeremy Valeriote will be sworn into office today at the legislature and Lowan has already set the tone for her tenure.

canada.title: Sold! Why live cattle auctions still matter to Alberta ranchers in an era of online bidding
canada.summary: Ranchers say you can still tell when it’s auction day in farming towns: trucks are lined up on the streets, the coffee shops are busy and local commerce surges.

canada.title: Winnipeg police required to note race in use-of-force reports
canada.summary: The Winnipeg Police Service has historically kept track of some race information but, as of last month, officers must include it in reports when force has been used in a case.

canada.title: Halifax staff recommend 6.8% hike on average residential property tax bill
canada.summary: On Tuesday, Halifax regional council starts the process for the 2027-2028 budget.

canada.title: Two Americans to be sentenced in murder of Quebec entrepreneur, partner
canada.summary: Two Americans convicted of murdering Quebec entrepreneur Daniel Langlois and his partner Dominique Marchand in Dominica are set to be sentenced Monday.

canada.title: How will Mark Carney's appeal influence the Yorkton-Melville byelection?
canada.summary: The Liberals are running Aaron Kienle, the sitting Mayor of Yorkton, as their candidate in the byelection set for Dec. 7.

canada.title: Cyberattack compromised personal customer information, Bell MTS says
canada.summary: Bell MTS experienced a cyberattack earlier this week that resulted in customer email account lockouts and password resets, the telecom provider said in a statement to CBC Sunday evening.

canada.title: Deadly rabbit disease outbreak sweeps through snowshoe hares in Alberta
canada.summary: The Alberta government is monitoring what it says is an unprecedented outbreak of rabbit hemorrhagic disease among snowshoe hares. The highly contagious viral disease doesn't harm humans, but kills nearly 90 per cent of infected rabbits and hares.

canada.title: Unlimited strike? Quebec students to announce next steps after weekend vote
canada.summary: Two weeks after leading a week-long protest, a group representing students across the province is set to announce its next move — and it may be an unlimited strike this winter.

canada.title: Ottawa recruiting commissioners for wrongful-conviction review body
canada.summary: The federal government is beginning recruitment for its independent Miscarriage of Justice Review Commission.

canada.title: Advocates not surprised Sask. leading provinces in intimate partner violence rates
canada.summary: A new Statistics Canada report shows Saskatchewan's rate of intimate partner violence in 2025 was nearly double the national average. Advocates say they aren't surprised by the numbers, but hope more education about intimate partner violence and healthy relationships will bring them down.

canada.title: Rising deer numbers in Fredericton backyards a concern for residents
canada.summary: Residents in Fredericton notice deer in their backyards and on the sides of roads, leaving them to wonder what's brought about this increased activity in the city?

canada.title: Coroner's inquest to begin for man who died in Saint John police cell
canada.summary: A coroner's inquest begins Monday into the death of a man in Saint John police custody nearly three years ago.

canada.title: ‘Big win for Atlantic Canada’: N.S. seafood exporters welcome Chinese tariff pause
canada.summary: Nova Scotia seafood exporters welcome a deal suspending China’s 25 per cent tariffs on whelk and sea cucumber after a year of stalled shipments.
